wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here. Answer one sideways question to get a first world, or skip it and pick any card below.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: See every way the site asks, every answer it can reach, and jump straight to any world from there.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan the whole site at once, with one plain line on what each page is for and what to do there.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Slow down with one breathing ring and a dimmer that stays where you leave it; put one burden down and leave it down.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your sky at full scale: ask it for guidance, catch meteors, play it as a chime, orbit it, and mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Turn your stars into logbook entries, replay their order, and seal constellation snapshots as time capsules.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your saved sky into drifting echoes, click one thought at a time, and print an echo weather bulletin.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Kindle your stars as lanterns, drift them on purpose, and pull a ritual reading from the pattern they make.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow each saved star into a swaying plant, tap any stem for its thought, and ask the glasshouse for a forecast.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map your stars as pressure systems, launch probes into local microclimates, and print a forecast from the field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Mirror your sky into a rotating mandala, tune its symmetry, ripple it by touch, and print a geometry mantra.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Run any of the 256 elementary cellular automata, flip rules live, and watch tiny bit changes rewrite the whole mill.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Throw heavy blocks with pointer or keyboard, flip gravity, and turn raw momentum into a playable mess.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Plant into soil cross-sections, water and turn the ground, and watch roots route around stone and grit.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed any word into the fire and pull out a forged coinage with its own fake definition and citation.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Deal impossible specimens one by one, pin favorites to your drawer, and cross-reference strange matches.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Spin your constellation through changing rune sets, archive omens, and forge a downloadable sigil from the result.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Miss a page and you still land somewhere playable: a working radio, decoder, scope, and route back in.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: The same page list in XML, with relative paths so the whole site works under any publish path.
